note: Side A (yctimlin mcp-excalidraw-server 2.0.0). By-eye manifest of final-own.png (the tester's own frontend screenshot after the run) checked against sidecar.png (our render of the exported scene, painted: bound labels Excalifont 20, see ../../font-probe.png). defects.ruleGap: tool: apply that deletes and re-creates the same id loses it
defects.description: apply {delete:[a9,s-pg], create:[a9,s-pg,...]} replied created 5 / deleted 4 and echoed both arrows; get a9 then said not found. Cause (dist/cli/commands/elements.js apply): it runs create, then update, then delete, so the delete removed the just-created arrows. The tester blamed elbowed:true and never learnt the cause. The same order routes new arrows against pre-update positions (report §2.3).

defects.ruleGap: tool: points on a bound arrow are dropped at create
defects.description: A 4-point route with startElementId/endElementId came back as a straight 2-point arrow, no warning. Worked around with a follow-up update of x, y and points.

defects.ruleGap: tool: points-only update re-anchors a bound arrow
defects.description: update of s-pg points without x/y moved its origin to Trip's bottom edge; the line ran through the Postgres ellipse.

defects.ruleGap: duplicate arrow on top of another
defects.description: The tester created e-pay-k2 exactly over e-pay-k; invisible in the PNG, found only by reading query output.
